entries.title: Motion reference by @devteamdrew
entries.author: devteamdrew
entries.prompt_text: Design a 30-second minimalist animation that begins with one thin ink line drawn across warm off-white paper and slowly becomes {SUBJECT}. Keep it quiet and editorial: visible paper grain, black ink plus a single accent color, lines that draw on, branch and fold into shapes, and a small serif caption to close. Build it as one HTML file with SVG path animation driven by a frame clock, capture 1920×1080 at 30 fps with headless Chrome, encode with ffmpeg, and add a soft ambient score synthesized in code.

entries.title: Motion reference by @twoclipping
entries.author: twoclipping
entries.prompt_text: Choreograph a 14-second square UI motion loop in Remotion at 1440×1440 and 60 fps, synced to {SONG_FILE}. One black pill on a soft off-white canvas is clicked by a cursor and, with no cuts, keeps transforming into new interface pieces such as a download button, progress ring, file card, date picker, share sheet and notification, one change per beat. Use critically damped springs for size, radius and color, add crisp click sounds, and make the final frame match the first so it loops.

entries.title: Motion reference by @8co28
entries.author: 8co28
entries.prompt_text: Code a phone-friendly web app that makes kinetic-typography lyric videos in the Japanese lyric-PV style. The user pastes lyrics, plays {SONG_FILE} and taps a button as each line starts; the app then designs the video automatically with huge type, bold color fields, small labels and hard cuts, producing a fresh variation on every press. Add a timeline with cut markers, loop and shuffle toggles, per-line editing, and export a 1920×1080 MP4 through ffmpeg.wasm.

entries.title: Motion reference by @aiehon_aya
entries.author: aiehon_aya
entries.prompt_text: Produce a 15-second motion-design showreel for {BRAND}, timed so every event lands on a beat of a 128 BPM track. Write one HTML file with a pure drawFrame(n) function: bold kinetic type that slides, overshoots and bounces in, an easing-curve graph editor scene, shapes morphing from circle to square to star, a wireframe tunnel, and a finale where thousands of particles assemble the logo. Add motion blur, RGB-split glitches and film grain, synthesize the music in Python, capture frames with headless Chrome and mux with ffmpeg.

entries.title: Motion reference by @vvarrdi
entries.author: vvarrdi
entries.prompt_text: Animate the home screen of a crypto wallet app called {APP_NAME} as a 7-second clip, built in one HTML file at iPhone size. Over a deep navy gradient with a soft pulsing glow, a frosted-glass balance card rises into place, the total counts up to {BALANCE} with dimmed cents, a sparkline draws itself and coin badges pop in. Keep the easing calm and premium, present it in a phone frame on a light grey backdrop, and record at 2880×2160 with headless Chrome and ffmpeg.

entries.author: trq212
entries.prompt_text: Explore redesigns of my personal site {SITE_URL} in several distinct directions, critiquing and refining each round until the tone feels {DESIRED_TONE}. entries.title: Motion reference by @motion_conquest
entries.author: motion_conquest
entries.prompt_text: Design a 16-second, square 1440×1440 UI motion loop inspired by Apple's Liquid Glass, timed to {AUDIO_FILE}. One refractive glass shape floats over a soft pastel gradient wallpaper and, on each beat, transforms into a new control: a search field, a media card, a timer, a switch, a segmented picker and a notification, guided by a round translucent cursor that clicks and drags. Draw the glass with a WebGL refraction shader, animate with spring physics, add soft synthesized taps, and capture 60 fps frames with Playwright for ffmpeg.

entries.prompt_text: Turn the design decisions behind {SCREEN_OR_FEATURE} into a 40-second animated UX case study for job interviews. entries.prompt_text: Design sixteen looping UI motion studies in HTML and SVG, laid out as a 4×4 grid of rounded tiles on a warm off-white page under a title. entries.author: yasinozmeen
entries.prompt_text: Produce a showreel of {NUMBER} different animation styles, all drawn in code with no images or stock footage. Build every vignette as a deterministic canvas or SVG scene driven by time, add a synthesized music bed, render frames with headless Chrome and stitch a 3-to-4-minute reel at 1920×1080 with ffmpeg.
